title: Stay at Greyfield Inn on Cumberland Island
description: Arrive by private ferry at Cumberland Island and settle into Greyfield Inn, a Carnegie family house amid maritime forest. Days can unfold among live oaks, long beaches, birdlife, and the island’s free-roaming horses, with meals bringing you back to the inn. An overnight stay gives you time for the quiet after day visitors leave and the shoreline belongs to the evening.
teaser: Spend a night among Cumberland Island’s oaks and horses.
goodToKnow: Confirm the current nightly rate and what it includes. Ferry arrivals, bumpy island roads and stairs need planning.
whyItMightDelightYou: The ferry ride and the absence of ordinary traffic make the island feel like a world entered on purpose.
